cadastreAuthority: ANATI (national land authority); data served from the IGNTG/ANATI ArcGIS Enterprise at sigigntg.anati.gob.pa

portalsFound.observation: Found via web search (sigigntg.anati.gob.pa experience link). Public portal search lists ~45 public hosted feature services on /arcgisserver/rest/services/Hosted incl. PREDIOS_TITULADOS_MIGRADOS, FINCAS_MADRES, Fincas_tituladas_v1, CAPA DE PROPIETARIO MIGRADA (not queried, owner data), COMUNIDADES_TIERRAS_COLECTIVAS; 'Datos Fundamentales' experience lists 'Parcelas de Tierra' as a fundamental dataset.

82,902 polygons, maxRecordCount 2000. Fields: numero_finca, provincia/distrito/corregimiento names, estado_titulo, fecha_titulo, tipo_tramite. Only provinces Colon and Panama present (distinct provincia_nombre), i.e. a migrated subset.
NOT Panama: Dominican Republic cadastre hub.
MIVIOT open data hub: zoning/POT layers, no parcels.
Panama City municipal site: no geoportal link found (earlier guessed geoportal host resets).
